runtime_contract.hardware_policy: Record exact CUDA GPU. H100/H200 is the upstream-matched condition; other BF16-capable CUDA GPUs are retained as an explicitly different runtime condition, never silently pooled.

execution.phase1c_schedule: inherit byte-for-byte ordering from pinned Phase 1C manifest

analysis_descriptors: local unique canonical-response SHA-256 count for each of the 18 conditions across three repeats
local within-condition repeat deltas using frozen Phase 1A metrics
local all-nine canonical-vs-question-order pairwise comparisons using the Phase 1C method
same-condition local-vs-hosted typed-answer deltas for all 54 scheduled calls
local and hosted owner top-choice flips recorded separately
exact runtime, revision, encoding, joint-schema-code and joint-head provenance
invariants: The 54 experiment calls inherit the exact Phase 1C fixtures, question-order variants, repeats, and interleaved schedule.
The canary is executed before the 54-call experiment and cannot be used to tune requests, thresholds, or ordering.
No semantic parity, acceptable-delta, or causality threshold is frozen before local output.
No generic chat-generation path, quantized conversion, CPU offload, or alternative decision head is accepted as Phase 2A v0.1 evidence.
State truncation is rejected before inference for the canary and every scheduled request.
A non-H100/H200 run remains usable evidence only with its different hardware condition preserved in provenance.
Hosted evidence is read only from the pinned Phase 1C repository bundle and is never re-queried.
